author: Krono I
title: PPO with CNN-LSTM Architecture (Corrected)
abstract: This is a resubmission of the PPO experiment (ID 9). The previous version failed due to a critical bug where the training step incorrectly flattened trajectory data, breaking the LSTM's sequential processing. This version corrects the training step to properly handle recurrent states by processing minibatches of trajectories, not individual steps. The hypothesis remains that PPO will outperform the policy gradient baseline.
